scope: Finite responsibilities; source trace and prior witness inventory; root owns executed probes and final coverage. Step9 execution is separate.

slices.duty: Index module identities, production/test declarations, exports and closed package names
slices.result: Identity and export bits owned by declared module/symbol; catalog builtin/helper names are closed at package declaration boundary.
slices.gap: AST/source order drives IDs; catalog absence changes closed-name knowledge. Malformed-declaration locality is already Step7. Tests listed are source witnesses, not newly executed here.

slices.duty: Import visibility, alias collision, deployment/external and std namespaces
slices.result: Known local provider must own exported symbol; re-export-through-import rejected; aliases preserve owning SymbolId. Unknown deployment-bound imports are opaque; unknown unbound provider errors. std uses compiler-transcribed owner schemas.
slices.gap: Opaque unknown interfaces are intentional incomplete checking; no runtime/deployment admission certified. Plain imported CRUD alias ambiguity is deliberately unresolved E5006 boundary; imported fixtures use test scope.

slices.duty: Composition selection and imported canonical owner preservation
slices.result: Resolver records direct selected module IDs, diagnoses missing selection/cycles; imports do not create a new symbol owner.
slices.gap: Actual transitive inclusion and canonical dedup consumed in effects/IR are other lane/Step9; uses_resolved alone does not certify complete executable closure.

slices.duty: Lexical lookup, contextual facts, initializer order, alias scopes
slices.result: Nearest lexical binding precedes predicates/catalog; initializer resolves before new let binding. Active injected names cannot be hidden; absent contextual names remain legal. Language query rows may introduce own row.
slices.gap: Name spelling is insufficient for authority; contextual Event baseline is opaque but member consumers refine known handlers. Preferences restrictions and handler/actor authority are other lane. Bindings must survive source/catalog cohort if shared later.

slices.duty: Type paths, imported qualified members and field-chain fixpoint
negative_witness: same test suffix failures E3008; missing cross-package use E2001 source branch
slices.result: Qualified cross-package types require authored use; field chain resolves owner symbol IDs and repeated rounds settle forward references. Reuse carries representation/nullability without cloning creation metadata.
slices.gap: Failed private import can still feed qualified TypeRef but E2003 gates shipping; populated facts alone are not admitted source. Fixpoint is bounded structurally, not workload-qualified; graph cycles handled elsewhere.

slices.duty: Signature defaults resolve and type before body authorization
consumer: default purity/read checks in effects lane
negative_witness: same test later-param E2001 326-331; proposed self/default-actor probes
slices.result: Each default sees earlier parameters and nullable actor; supplied arguments replace omitted defaults. Type checker passes declared expected type and reports E3011 for impurity/type errors.
slices.gap: Default execution order and IR omitted/supplied parameter parity require Step9. Earlier parameter that shadows contextual spelling needs exact independent scenario probes; no new policy selected.

slices.duty: User function/message and operation argument bindings
slices.result: Positionals fill next unused param; named args use declaration names; omission requires default. Duplicate/unknown/extra failures suppress dependent missing errors while still typing supplied values. Roles retain separate one-positional-subject contract.
slices.gap: Ordinary calls, operation object bindings, action and invocation complete schemas are distinct responsibilities; no shared binder chosen. Parser named-order/duplicate checks are upstream, defensive checker behavior is not syntax acceptance.

slices.duty: Builtin overload binding, specificity, ties and trial inference
negative_witness: b4_check.rs:t11_overload_result_never_inhabits 2121-2133; root synthetic tie and real-catalog binding probes
slices.result: Best compatible overload counts nonempty/ordered markers; equal scores keep catalog order. Variables bind first actual and later loose equality; winning enum claims committed. Concrete scalars remain exact and unknown/error/opaque are lenient.
slices.gap: No exported winning overload/binding fact. Score is collection-marker count, not general type-specificity order. Catalog ties are implementation policy; no independent ambiguity contract discovered. Failed literal trials can write node_types before winner; source lead requiring witness.

slices.duty: Expected type, literal inhabitation, enum claim and closed structural inputs
slices.result: Expectations type literals/empty arrays/closed records; existing bindings outrank same-spelled enum cases. Assignment admits exact types and explicit nullable widening; no general int-variable->decimal coercion.
slices.gap: Potential order-sensitive nullable array element inference: strips nullability for comparison but keeps first element type. Independent root probe required; locale/email/etc validation is other lane. Unknown/opaque success is no proof of concrete validation.

slices.duty: Nullability, safe members, coalescing and stable declaration narrowing
slices.result: Plain nullable member reports E3003; safe member wraps once; fallback requires compatible nullable base. and-right gets left-true and or-right left-false facts; narrowing key is resolved declaration+path.
slices.gap: Mutation/send invalidation and authority predicates are other lane. Static branch checking does not execute short circuit; Step9 owns evaluation/once-only parity. Opaque paths deliberately defer concrete null checking.

slices.duty: Catalog loading, finite signature subset and availability
slices.result: Load first readable candidate; malformed present input fails. Duplicate entry IDs/malformed shape fail whole catalog. Planned builtin yields E6001 before overload errors even light positions; helper source use E2006; External builtin availability remains callable.
slices.gap: Catalog External and deployment External have different meaning. Nominal signature names outside known scalar table deliberately match leniently; complete external implementation/deployment availability is not certified by static call acceptance. Catalog schema permits no signature parameter defaults.

slices.duty: Unresolved-name ownership, cascade suppression and diagnostic dedup
positive_witness: compiler/tests/check.rs driver dedup/order tests; b4_check.rs enum expectation witnesses
slices.result: Resolver defers unresolved names for enum expectation; matched cases suppress E2001. Members dedup by NodeKey+name; final diagnostics dedup primary/code/message and sort file/start/code. Light examples headers are not full expression validation.
slices.gap: Dedup excludes severity/related/fixes from its key and retains first finding; removal would require diagnostic carrier contract qualification. Absence from node_types or clean light typing is no certification. Step7 malformed owner/sibling defects remain open.
